title: Correct color identification
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the perceived color as green based on the calculated wavelength.

title: Wavelength calculation
description: Important Criteria: The response should show the correct calculation of wavelength using λ = c/v with the given frequency and speed of light.

title: Unit conversion to nanometers
description: Important Criteria: The response should convert the calculated wavelength from meters to nanometers (500 nm) for color identification.

title: Physics relationship application
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly apply the relationship between wave speed, frequency, and wavelength.

title: Incorrect color from wavelength
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student calculates the correct wavelength but misidentifies the corresponding color (e.g., says blue or yellow instead of green).

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect formula (e.g., λ = v/c instead of λ = c/v) for wavelength calculation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The response may demonstrate proper unit handling throughout the calculation process.
